name: File menus expose templates; Insert exposes signatories
Signatories validate names and insert editable names and positions
Refresh is quiet after durable draft save; warns before unpersisted edits; restores after reload
Open Template creates voucher copy; Save Template creates company template without replacing document
Using a saved template never updates original; Open/Delete are grouped at right
Edit Template updates explicitly; ordinary Save blocks template overwrite; restored template keeps protection
Template connection failure and stale version retain editable draft
Tablet library groups actions and signatory form fits the viewport
Dynamic headings use title capitalization while acronyms, body text and edited documents are preserved
